config.field: sum_j exp(-exact_squared_distance(grid_vertex, full_raw_path_j)/(2*sigma_m^2)); edge cost uses mean of both vertices
config.included_prior_paths: every returned complete raw path, including paths failing later observation proxy or evaluation checks
config.virtual_edges: unchanged original start/goal edge Counter costs
config.preflight_selection_rule: fixed first4 TRAIN parents and all3 instructions; no outcome-based sigma/cost/search/geometry tuning
config.dev_launch: separate root-controlled launch after sealed mechanical TRAIN preflight; do not autonomously extend
config.decision_boundary: If TRAIN has no coverage gain, diagnose whether known positive TRAIN alternatives survive the original observed free-map before changing penalties; no second module or automatic retuning.
config.claim: standard diverse-planning adaptation, not method novelty or invalid-aware coverage
config.status: implemented prospective protocol; no experiment launched

planner_config.target_contact_radius_rule: half TRAIN prototype extent plus one voxel
planner_config.unknown_policy: blocked except recorded local current/target contact allowances
planner_config.collision_scope: discrete visible-free-space proxy, not a continuous 2cm physical-clearance certificate; depth projection and surface/grid quantization errors are not jointly bounded
planner_config.diagonal_policy: all touched neighbor voxels, including edge/corner ties, must be free
planner_config.attachment_scope: original neighboring free cells within unchanged start/target contact radii; target component unchanged
planner_config.connector_collision_scope: complete segment distance to finite nonselected visible points >= original 20mm plus fixed-step observed-ray/contact checks; not continuous solid/visibility certification

prototype_config.component_rule: mean color likelihood times soft TRAIN metric-extent prior
prototype_config.prediction_rule: observed point nearest component world-coordinate median
